metadata.title: Chip stocks are rising, as Anthropic's IPO revives the AI trade for a second day - MarketWatch

content.text:
9 min ago
Chip stocks are rising, as Anthropic's IPO revives the AI trade for a second day
Anthropic's much-anticipated IPO is reviving the AI trade for a second day on Wall Street, with shares of semiconductor names and megacap tech stocks continuing to buoy the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite on Tuesday morning.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was popping 2.3%, bringing its week-to-date rally to more than 5%. Shares of Micron Technology were rising 1.9%, while Super Micro Computer was up 3.2% and Oracle Corp. was up 3.4%, according to FactSet data.
